ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The ratio is extremely low; approximately 98% of the fluke surface consists of low-intensity dark pixels, with high-intensity white pixels restricted to distal barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation across both lobes; two distinct high-contrast white clusters (geometric blobs) are mapped to the distal tips at the extreme lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth roughly 20% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire margin; peaks vary between 3-15 pixels in amplitude, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lobes exhibit a concave upward curvature (concave trajectory) as the margin approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) are located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiotic colonization on the lateral tips; highly irregular trailing edge suggesting possible historic tissue degradation or minor trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric barnacle density, with the right distal tip showing a more voluminous cluster than the left distal tip.
